refnamediv.refpurpose: Render a Varlink interface definition as text or JSON

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: sd_varlink_idl_format() renders the specified interface definition, as built with the SD_VARLINK_DEFINE_INTERFACE() family of macros or parsed with sd_varlink_idl_parse(), as text in the Varlink interface definition language (IDL). Documentation comments are rendered along with the definition, and the output is not colorized and not wrapped, so that it is byte-for-byte reproducible.

sd_varlink_idl_format_json() renders the same definition as a JSON object. Symbols and fields are emitted in declaration order, call flags in the canonical order, and the key set is fixed, so that the output is deterministic as well. The representation carries the same information as the textual form, including documentation comments and the marking of experimental interfaces, symbols and fields. It is not yet part of UAPI.20 Varlink IPC: the key set below is the interface this function guarantees.
The caller owns the returned text and the returned JSON variant, respectively, and is responsible for freeing them.

refsect1.title: JSON representation
refsect1.para: The top-level object describes the interface itself:

listitem.para: true when the interface is marked experimental. Only present when the interface is experimental.
The documentation comment of the interface. Only present when the definition carries one.
An array of symbol objects, in declaration order. Always present, and empty for an interface without symbols.

refsect1.para: Each symbol object describes one method, error or type:

listitem.para: One of method, error or type. Always present.
As for the interface, for this symbol.
For methods and errors, the call flags that apply, in the canonical order: supports-more, requires-more, supports-upgrade and requires-upgrade. Only present when at least one flag applies.
For methods, the input and output parameters as arrays of field objects. Always present, and empty for a method without parameters.
For errors and struct types, the fields as an array of field objects. Always present.
For enum types, the values as an array of objects with the keys name, experimental and comment, with the same rules as for a symbol. Always present.
For types, either struct or enum. Always present on a type.

refsect1.para: Each field object carries the field name in name, and the keys experimental and comment with the same rules as above. Its type is described by exactly one of the following keys:

listitem.para: A primitive type: bool, int, float, string, object or any.
The name of a type declared in the same interface.
An inline struct, as an array of field objects, or an inline enum, as an array of objects with name, experimental and comment.
true when the field carries the corresponding modifier. Each key is only present when the modifier applies.

refsect1.title: Return Value
refsect1.para: On success, these functions return a non-negative integer. On failure, they return a negative errno-style error code. In particular, -ENOMEM is returned when memory allocation fails.

refsect1.title: History
refsect1.para: sd_varlink_idl_format() was added in version 257. sd_varlink_idl_format_json() was added in version 263.
